commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
SHA=578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch --detach "$SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-rounding-126-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/map.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep 'pinned media portrait cards can shrink to the tile minimum' --repeat-each=5 --workers=1
cd ..
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'verified_sha=%s\n' "$SHA"
trap - EXIT
rm -rf "$VENV"
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
